purpose: Teach: 電信/依拠/手がける/内地/買い換え/受取/田舎町/廃業

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、戦時下の電信記録を史料として研究しろ
lines.en: Ren — I want you to research wartime telegraph records as primary source material.
lines.style: Calm, direct authority. Measured cadence. No rush. The kind of instruction a mentor gives when he's already confident in the person receiving it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文は先行研究に依拠しております
lines.en: Yes. My paper is built on the prior research in the field.
lines.style: Careful, slightly formal. Seeking approval but not defensively. Steady pace. The precision of someone checking his own work aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室で新テーマを手がけるチームを作れ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to form a team in the lab to tackle a new research direction.
lines.style: Clear assignment. Slight weight on 'form' — not a suggestion. Still warm, not cold. The confidence of delegating up.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。内地の研究者との交流を学会で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I presented collaborative work with domestic researchers at the conference.
lines.style: Dutiful. Maintaining formality even as he reaches to answer what he thinks is being asked. A beat of uncertainty underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、古い実験機材の買い換えを申請しろ
lines.en: Ren — I need the equipment request filed. The old instruments need replacing.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. Not harsh. The tone of someone checking essential boxes. Expects compliance without drama.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の受取書を提出いたしました
lines.en: Yes. I've submitted the receipts for the research funds.
lines.style: Quiet formality. Slightly stiff — he's answering what was asked but sensing a gap between the instruction and his response. Dutiful exhale.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、田舎町でのフィールドワークも計画しろ
lines.en: Ren — plan fieldwork in the countryside as well. That's part of this too.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact addition. The final piece. No hesitation. Still measured, but the scope is broadening and he's stating it clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の廃業は最終手段と考えております
lines.en: Yes. If needed, closing the lab would be the last resort — I understand the stakes.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. Ren finally hears what isn't being said. Slow, careful. The words of someone who just realized the scope of what he's been asked to do.
